annotations.title: Insider buys by ticker, today, or a date range (SEC Form 4)

description: Use when the user asks which insiders bought a stock, whether a ticker has insider buying, or for Form 4 buys in a date range. Pass `ticker`, `start`+`end` for an inclusive ISO range, or neither for today's buys (SEC code P); `days` narrows, `include_unlisted` adds non-listed issuers. Each row carries filing_url, `offering_context`, `transaction_date`, `acceptance_datetime`, `aff10b5One` (10b5-1 flag), `is_amendment`/`original_accession` (4/A linkage), and `partial_fields` (reason for any null). Caveat: only purchases that pass the signal filter are returned; code P is not proof of a buy.

as_of.description: Publish-boundary replay: UTC ISO-8601 instant (or a bare YYYY-MM-DD, read as end-of-day UTC). Returns only rows that had crossed the publish boundary at or before it — the exact feed visible at that past moment. Each row carries `first_served_at` (null on rows published before the stamp existed; those are kept, as they were already public).

days.description: Only rows filed within the last N days (relative to today).

end.description: Inclusive range end, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Give with `start` for a date range.

include_unlisted.description: Include unlisted issuers (blank/NONE/N/A tickers and 5-letter mutual-fund classes). Default false = exchange-listed common stock only. Every row carries a `listed_equity` boolean.

limit.description: Max rows to return (default 25, newest first). Page with offset; the response's total_matched shows the full count. limit<=0 = no cap.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page (pagination). Default 0.

start.description: Inclusive range start, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Give with `end` for a date range.

ticker.description: Case-insensitive exact ticker filter, e.g. DKS.
